exercises.instructions: Rewrite the following sentences in reported speech. Choose the correct reported form.

questions.question: "I don't speak Italian," she said. → She said that ___.
questions.explanation: Simple Present → Simple Past: don't speak → didn't speak. Simple Present ကို Simple Past ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

questions.question: "I never make mistakes," he said. → He said that ___.
questions.explanation: Simple Present → Simple Past: make → made. Simple Present ကို Simple Past ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

questions.question: They said, "We are busy." → They said that ___.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous → Past Continuous: are → were. Present Continuous ကို Past Continuous ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

questions.question: He said, "I know a better restaurant." → He said that ___.
options: he had known a better restaurant
questions.explanation: Simple Present → Simple Past: know → knew. Simple Present ကို Simple Past ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

questions.question: She said, "I am not hungry now." → She said ___.
options: she had not been hungry then
questions.explanation: Present Continuous → Past Continuous + time change: now → then. Present Continuous ကို Past Continuous ပြောင်းပြီး time word ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

questions.question: She said, "It is very quiet here." → She said ___.
options: it had been very quiet there
questions.explanation: Simple Present → Simple Past + place change: here → there. Simple Present ကို Simple Past ပြောင်းပြီး place word ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

questions.question: "Don't play on the grass, boys," she said. → She told the boys ___.
options: to not play on the grass
not to play on the grass
questions.answer: not to play on the grass
questions.explanation: Negative command: don't + verb → not + to + verb. Negative command မှာ don't → not to ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: "Where is your sister?" she asked me. → She asked me ___.
questions.explanation: Wh-question: is → was (tense shift back). Wh-question မှာ tense shift back ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: "How are you?" Martin asked us. → Martin asked us ___.
questions.explanation: Wh-question: are → were (tense shift back). Wh-question မှာ tense shift back ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: He asked, "Do I have to do it?" → He asked ___.
options: if he has to do it
if he had to do it
whether he has to do it
questions.answer: if he had to do it
questions.explanation: Yes/No question with 'do': use 'if' + tense shift back. Yes/No question မှာ 'if' သုံးပြီး tense shift back ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: "Which dresses do you like best?" she asked her boyfriend. → She asked her boyfriend ___.
options: which dresses does he like best
questions.explanation: Wh-question: do like → liked (tense shift back). Wh-question မှာ tense shift back ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: The teacher asked, "Who speaks English?" → The teacher wanted to know ___.
questions.explanation: Wh-question: speaks → spoke (tense shift back). Wh-question မှာ tense shift back ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: "Is it your birthday today?" Beth asked Nathan. → Beth asked Nathan ___.
options: if it was his birthday that day
if it is his birthday today
whether it was his birthday today
questions.answer: if it was his birthday that day
questions.explanation: Yes/No question: is → was, your → his, today → that day. Yes/No question မှာ tense, pronoun, time word ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

questions.question: "Say hello to Jim," they said. → They asked me ___.
questions.explanation: Command/request: say → to say. Command/request မှာ to + verb ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: "Be careful, Ben," she said. → She told Ben ___.
questions.explanation: Command/request: be → to be. Command/request မှာ to + verb ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: She said, "Go upstairs." → She told me ___.
questions.explanation: Command/request: go → to go. Command/request မှာ to + verb ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: "Close the door behind you," he told me. → He told me ___.
options: to close the door behind me
questions.answer: to close the door behind me
questions.explanation: Command/request: close → to close, you → me. Command/request မှာ to + verb ဖြစ်ပြီး pronoun ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

questions.question: "Stop staring at me," she said. → She told him ___.
questions.explanation: Command/request: stop → to stop, me → her. Command/request မှာ to + verb ဖြစ်ပြီး pronoun ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

questions.question: "Leave me alone," she said. → She told me ___.
questions.explanation: Command/request: leave → to leave, me → her. Command/request မှာ to + verb ဖြစ်ပြီး pronoun ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

questions.question: "John, stop smoking," she said. → She told John ___.
questions.explanation: Command/request: stop → to stop. Command/request မှာ to + verb ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: "What's the time?" he asked. → He wanted to know ___.
questions.explanation: Wh-question: is → was (tense shift back). Wh-question မှာ tense shift back ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: "Are you crazy?" she asked him. → She asked him ___.
questions.explanation: Yes/No question: are → was, you → he. Yes/No question မှာ 'if' သုံးပြီး tense shift back ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: "Why don't you help me?" she asked him. → She wanted to know ___.
questions.explanation: Wh-question: don't → didn't, you → he, me → her. Wh-question မှာ tense shift back ဖြစ်ပြီး pronoun ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

questions.question: "The film began at seven o'clock," he said. → He said that ___.
options: the film has begun at seven o'clock
the film had begun at seven o'clock
the film began at seven o'clock
questions.answer: the film had begun at seven o'clock
questions.explanation: Simple Past → Past Perfect: began → had begun. Simple Past ကို Past Perfect ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

questions.question: "I was very tired," she said. → She said that ___.
questions.explanation: Simple Past → Past Perfect: was → had been. Simple Past ကို Past Perfect ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

questions.question: She said, "I did not say that." → She said that ___.
questions.explanation: Simple Past → Past Perfect: did not say → had not said. Simple Past ကို Past Perfect ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

questions.question: "Where did you spend your holidays last year?" she asked me. → She asked me ___.
options: where I spent my holidays last year
where I had spent my holidays the previous year
where did I spend my holidays last year
questions.answer: where I had spent my holidays the previous year
questions.explanation: Wh-question: did spend → had spent, your → my, last year → the previous year. Wh-question မှာ tense shift back ဖြစ်ပြီး pronoun နဲ့ time word ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

questions.question: She said, "I went to the cinema yesterday." → She said that ___.
options: she went to the cinema yesterday
she had gone to the cinema the day before
she has gone to the cinema the day before
questions.answer: she had gone to the cinema the day before
questions.explanation: Simple Past → Past Perfect + time change: went → had gone, yesterday → the day before. Simple Past ကို Past Perfect ပြောင်းပြီး time word ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

questions.question: "I will do this for him," you said. → You said that ___.
options: you will do this for him
you had done that for him
you would do that for him
questions.answer: you would do that for him
questions.explanation: Modal change: will → would, this → that. Modal verb will ကို would ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

questions.question: He said, "They won't sleep." → He said that ___.
questions.explanation: Modal change: won't → wouldn't. Modal verb won't ကို wouldn't ပြောင်းပါတယ်။
